prompt: On what date did the world record 100 million covid cases, a milestone that signifies the sheer amount of transmission that has occurred around this virus?
answer: The world reached **100 million recorded COVID-19 cases on January 26, 2021** (widely reported on January 27, depending on the tracker and time zone).
